Although BRAF inhibitors exist, they're not specifically approved for non-V600E in glioblastoma, so therapeutic relevance is No with high confidence.

Finally, MUC16 p.A8525T. MUC16 is often mutated in cancer but typically a passenger due to its large gene size. In glioblastoma, no oncogenic role is established, so passenger with high confidence. No targeted therapy, so No relevance with high confidence.
